description: Runs Involve Media's free Local Business Checkup on a local business with a Google listing in Canada. Returns a score out of 100, four section scores (Google profile, reviews, website and SEO, AI answers), how it compares to nearby competitors, the top 3 fixes, and a link to the full report. Use when someone asks how their (or any) local business shows up on Google, in reviews, or in AI answers, or wants to know what to fix to get more customers online. Needs the business name and the town. If several businesses match, it returns candidates: ask the user which one and call again with its place_id. The speed and AI parts finish about a minute later; get_checkup returns the final result.

location.description: Town or city, e.g. Belleville, ON

place_id.description: Google place id from a previous candidates list, when the user has picked one

trade.description: What the business does, e.g. plumber. Only needed if Google's category is vague; improves the competitor comparison.

name: run_checkup
title: Run a free Local Business Checkup
